method: packages/source-metrics/scripts/topology-probe.ts replays axis grouping, candidate generation and the global assignment on every sealed plan frame of the final development matrix (recogniser ON), from the sealed metric evidence alone; metricTopologyMs is each run's own telemetry (METRIC_FRAMES subphases CHAINS, LABEL_ASSIGNMENT, ORIENTATION, SCALE: chain finding, mark classification, the page vote, the independent solver and the final re-read). Timings on a shared 4-core container; not a phone. Telemetry attributes time to the subphase of the last tick, so LABEL_ASSIGNMENT runs from the first neighbourhood heartbeat to the next subphase and includes the page vote and chain solves after it; the assignment itself is the probe's `totals.assignmentMs` (all 135 frames).
